_note: Tagging vocabulary for the Surtiflavour Voice-of-Customer sheet. Segments follow the brand guide (section 10) plus the store-floor brief: business owners and senior corporate employees travelling abroad for business tours, family vacations and friends trips. Tags are AI-assigned; quotes never are.

S01.label: Business traveller abroad (veg)
S01.definition: Business owner or senior corporate employee on a work trip, trade fair or client visit abroad. Time-poor, often eating alone or with colleagues.

S02.label: Family vacationer abroad (veg)
S02.definition: Family with children and/or elders on a self-planned international holiday.

S03.label: Friends / couple leisure traveller abroad (veg)
S03.definition: Friend group, couple or honeymooners on a leisure trip abroad.

S04.label: Jain / no onion-garlic traveller
S04.definition: Strict Jain, Swaminarayan, satvik or fasting traveller for whom 'vegetarian' is not enough.

S05.label: Group-tour customer (package tour)
S05.definition: Traveller on an escorted package tour who paid for 'Indian meals included'.

S06.label: Senior / parent visiting family abroad
S06.definition: Elderly parents flying to visit children abroad, usually with diet restrictions and long transits.

S07.label: Student abroad
S07.definition: Indian student living abroad: tight budget, little time or skill to cook, homesick.

S08.label: Parent / relative sending parcels
S08.definition: Family member in India packing or couriering food to someone abroad.

S09.label: NRI / expat missing home food
S09.definition: Working professional or family settled abroad who misses regional Indian food.

S10.label: Pilgrim / trekker / train traveller (India)
S10.definition: Char Dham and other yatras, Himalayan treks, long train journeys and remote road trips inside India.

S11.label: Hostel student / bachelor (India)
S11.definition: Hostel, PG or bachelor living in India who wants something better than instant noodles.

S12.label: Ready-to-eat buyer (home / office)
S12.definition: Buys ready-to-eat or instant meals for home, office or emergencies and judges taste, value and ingredients.

T01.label: Pre-trip food anxiety
T01.definition: The 'what will we eat there?' worry before booking or packing.

T02.label: Veg food scarcity at destination
T02.definition: Cannot find vegetarian food; survives on fries, bread, salad or fruit.

T03.label: Hidden non-veg & purity fear
T03.definition: Fish sauce, egg, lard, shared oil or utensils; cannot trust the word 'vegetarian'; language barrier.

T04.label: Jain / no onion-garlic constraints
T04.definition: Jain food unavailable; root vegetables, sunset rule, fasting days.

T05.label: Cost of eating out abroad
T05.definition: Indian restaurants abroad are expensive; per-meal price shock.

T06.label: Time lost hunting for food
T06.definition: Itinerary bent around finding food; long detours; late-night hunger.

T07.label: Bland-food fatigue & craving
T07.definition: Craving dal-chawal, roti, spice or chai after days of unfamiliar food.

T08.label: Carry-from-home workaround
T08.definition: Thepla, khakhra, ready-to-eat packs, instant noodles, pickles: what and how much they pack.

T09.label: Cooking in the hotel room
T09.definition: Kettle, rice cooker, electric cooker or induction hacks; fear of smell, fire alarm or fines.

T10.label: Hot water / kettle / heating access
T10.definition: No kettle or microwave; begging the hotel or a cafe for hot water.

T11.label: Airport security & customs fear
T11.definition: What is allowed, declaration, seized food and fines.

T12.label: Baggage weight & packing hassle
T12.definition: Food eating into the baggage allowance; bulk, leaks and smell in luggage.

T13.label: Tour-operator food: promise vs reality
T13.definition: Group-tour Indian meals that are repetitive, late, far away or poor.

T14.label: RTE taste & texture disappointment
T14.definition: 'All taste the same', too oily, spicy or sour, rubbery, not like home.

T15.label: RTE quantity & value for money
T15.definition: Portion too small for the price; not filling.

T16.label: RTE health & ingredient worry
T16.definition: Preservatives, sodium, palm oil, acidity, shelf-life distrust, expiry.

T17.label: Packaging & delivery failures
T17.definition: Leaked, puffed or damaged packs; near-expiry stock; late delivery.

T18.label: Kids' & elders' food needs
T18.definition: Picky children, elderly or diabetic diets, need for familiar food.

T19.label: Homesickness & taste of home
T19.definition: Missing ghar ka khana; food as emotional comfort.

T20.label: Student budget & cooking fatigue
T20.definition: No time or skill to cook; groceries and eating out are expensive.

T21.label: Parcels from home
T21.definition: Courier cost, customs, spoilage and what to send.

T22.label: Yatra / trek / train food struggle
T22.definition: Hygiene fears, instant-noodle monotony, altitude, limited options.

T23.label: Buying triggers & trust signals
T23.definition: What made them buy or recommend: tasting, reviews, shelf life, Jain label, price comparison.

T24.label: Delight & desired outcome
T24.definition: 'Felt like home', 'saved our trip': what a good solution feels like.

T25.label: Social embarrassment & judgement
T25.definition: Being judged for carrying or cooking Indian food; pride versus shame.
